from.place: proof step 2: refinement of an fppf covering of an affine object by affine objects

title: Affine refinement of an fppf covering
statement: Let U = Spec(A) be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{T_i \to U\}_{i \in I}$ be an fppf covering family [def-pc-fppf-site]. There are finitely many indices i(1), ..., i(m), affine open subschemes V_j contained in T_{i(j)}, and factorizations $V_j \to T_{i(j)} \to U$ such that each $V_j \to U$ is fppf and the images of the V_j jointly cover U.
